$Comment: Wear the whole Hallowed Set: its four armour pieces with a Jack Shield (or the Flaming Jack Shield)
in the utility slot. GEAR_SET_TIER counts a set's bonus tier coming on as gear goes on, its amount
the number of pieces that tier takes, so Amount 5 is met the moment the set's five-piece tier
(GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json) comes on. Logging in already dressed counts
nothing: the pieces have to go on.
Earned once and kept, like Hallowed Armour, the first rung of the chain wear_hallows_eve_hallowed:
no Parent, no hallowed tag, and nothing paid but its points. The criterion's TextKey words the
step, since the shared sentence names the set by its raw id.
